name: Reflect Arrows (Combat)
body:
You redirect ranged attacks at your foes.

Prerequisite: Dex 15, Deflect Arrows, Improved Unarmed Strike, Combat Reflexes

Benefit: When you deflect an attack from a ranged weapon, you may redirect the attack to a foe within the first range increment of the attack. Take a -4 on your attack roll and add your strength modifier to damage. This uses up an attack of opportunity for the round.
